issues.legal_issue: Whether bail orders for accused facing serious offences are sustainable when the court granting bail failed to consider the gravity and nature of the allegations and give cogent reasons.
Whether participation in an unlawful assembly may justify bail on the ground that an accused had no independent overt act.
Whether the absence of alleged misuse of bail after release makes otherwise unsustainable bail orders immune from being set aside.
Whether overcrowding of jails is a sufficient consideration for granting bail in cases involving serious offences.
